description: Backend security hardening, schema additions, new query files, elevated_admin role, env/middleware extensions, Telegram scheduler, devotionalRouter/telegramRouter rewrites, mediaRouter, authRouter promotion, and Neon-first DB comment. This is the complete backend FEAT — all 17 plan items that touch api/, db/, and contracts/.
steps: Step 1 — api/middleware.ts: Add `requireRoles(roles: string[])` middleware factory (throws FORBIDDEN if ctx.user.role not in array). Export `elevatedAdminQuery = authedQuery.use(requireRoles(['admin', 'elevated_admin']))`. Do NOT change existing requireRole or adminQuery.

Step 2 — api/lib/env.ts: Add six new env vars using the existing `get()` helper: telegramBotToken (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN), telegramWebhookSecret (TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET), telegramChannelId (TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID, default ''), cloudinaryCloudName (CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME), cloudinaryApiKey (CLOUDINARY_API_KEY), cloudinaryApiSecret (CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET).

Step 3 — .env.example: Add TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET (under Telegram section), CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_API_KEY, CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET (new section '── 8. Cloudinary Media Storage'). Move NEON_DATABASE_URL above DATABASE_URL (swap their order in the file).

Step 4 — db/schema.ts: (a) Add `mediaUrl: text('media_url')` column to the devotionals table definition, after the `author` column. (b) Add `mediaUploads` pgTable with columns: id serial PK, userId uuid FK→users ON DELETE CASCADE, cloudinaryUrl text NOT NULL, supabaseUrl text (nullable), fileName varchar(500) NOT NULL, mimeType varchar(100) NOT NULL, fileSize integer (nullable), createdAt timestamp defaultNow. Add index idx_media_uploads_user on userId. Export `MediaUpload = typeof mediaUploads.$inferSelect` and `InsertMediaUpload = typeof mediaUploads.$inferInsert`. (c) Update the role column comment on users table to document values: 'user' | 'admin' | 'elevated_admin'.

Step 5 — db/supabase-schema.sql: Append at the bottom: ALTER TABLE public.devotionals ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS media_url TEXT; Then full CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.media_uploads block matching the Drizzle schema. Add ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Add policies: 'Users can insert own media' (for INSERT where auth.uid() = user_id), 'Users can view own media' (SELECT using auth.uid() = user_id), 'Admins can view all media' (SELECT using EXISTS (select 1 from public.users where id = auth.uid() and role in ('admin','elevated_admin'))).

Step 6 — api/queries/devotionals.ts (NEW FILE): Import getDb from './connection', devotionals table from '@db/schema', Drizzle operators (eq, desc, gte, and, sql). Implement and export: getDevotionalById(id: number), getTodayDevotional(), listDevotionals({limit: number, offset: number, publishedOnly: boolean}), createDevotional(data: InsertDevotional), updateDevotional(id: number, data: Partial<InsertDevotional>), deleteDevotional(id: number), publishDevotional(id: number), listDevotionalsBySource(source: string). Return types: Promise<Devotional | undefined> or Promise<{items: Devotional[], total: number}> as appropriate.

Step 7 — api/queries/telegram.ts (NEW FILE): Import getDb from './connection', telegramMessages from '@db/schema', Drizzle operators. Implement and export: getTelegramMessageById(id: number), listTelegramMessages({limit: number, offset: number, processedFilter?: boolean}), markTelegramMessageProcessed(id: number, devotionalId: number), insertTelegramMessage(data: InsertTelegramMessage). Return typed Promise results using TelegramMessage and InsertTelegramMessage types.

Step 8 — api/queries/media.ts (NEW FILE): Import getDb from './connection', mediaUploads from '@db/schema'. Implement and export: logMediaUpload({userId: string, cloudinaryUrl: string, supabaseUrl?: string, fileName: string, mimeType: string, size?: number}): Promise<MediaUpload | undefined>. Insert into mediaUploads table and return the created row.

Step 9 — api/devotionalRouter.ts (FULL REWRITE): Keep today/byId/list as publicQuery. Change create to elevatedAdminQuery. Add update (elevatedAdminQuery), delete (elevatedAdminQuery), publish (elevatedAdminQuery). Import elevatedAdminQuery from './middleware'. Import query functions from './queries/devotionals'. Input schemas: all string fields use .trim() in the Zod transform (use z.string().trim().max(N)) — title max 500, body max 10000, scripture max 500, prayer max 3000, reflection max 3000, author max 255. Add mediaUrl: z.string().url().optional() to create and update. After every mutation (create/update/delete/publish): fire-and-forget fetch POST to `${env.supabaseUrl}/realtime/v1/api/broadcast` with header `Authorization: Bearer ${env.supabaseServiceRoleKey}` and JSON body `{ topic: 'devotionals', event: 'devotional_changed', payload: { id, action } }` — wrap in try/catch, log errors but do not throw.

Step 10 — api/telegramRouter.ts: Change messages and processMessage procedures from publicQuery to adminQuery. Update import line at top to include adminQuery. Replace inline DB calls in messages query and processMessage mutation with listTelegramMessages() and markTelegramMessageProcessed()/getTelegramMessageById()/tryCreateDevotionalFromMessage() from queries/telegram.ts. Keep webhook as publicQuery.

Step 11 — api/boot.ts: (a) Add webhook secret header check at the start of the /api/telegram/webhook Hono route handler: read header 'x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token', compare to env.telegramWebhookSecret (skip check if env.telegramWebhookSecret is empty string — dev mode); return c.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401) on mismatch. (b) After the `if (env.isProduction && !isServerless)` block, add scheduler: define `lastFiredSlot: Record<string, Date | null> = { '2': null, '4': null }`. setInterval every 60_000ms; inside: get now = new Date(); const h = now.getHours(); const m = now.getMinutes(); if (m === 0 && (h === 2 || h === 4)) { const slot = String(h); if (!lastFiredSlot[slot] || now.getTime() - lastFiredSlot[slot]!.getTime() > 60*60*1000) { lastFiredSlot[slot] = now; pollTelegramMessages().catch(e => console.error('[scheduler]', e)); } }. Only start interval if env.telegramBotToken && !isServerless. (c) Add pollTelegramMessages() async function: maintains module-level let updateOffset = 0. Fetches `https://api.telegram.org/bot${env.telegramBotToken}/getUpdates?offset=${updateOffset}&timeout=0`. For each update in result.result: call insertTelegramMessage(data) from queries/telegram.ts, call tryCreateDevotional(db, messageId, text). After all processed: set updateOffset to last update_id + 1. (d) Add Neon-first comment block at top of api/lib/db.ts explaining Neon→Supabase→stub priority (no code change, comment only).

Step 12 — api/mediaRouter.ts (NEW FILE): Import createRouter, adminQuery from './middleware'. Import env from './lib/env'. Import logMediaUpload from './queries/media'. Import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto'. Import { nanoid } from 'nanoid'. Export mediaRouter = createRouter({ uploadUrl: adminQuery.input(...).mutation(...), archiveToSupabase: adminQuery.input(...).mutation(...) }). uploadUrl input: { fileName: z.string().max(500), mimeType: z.string().max(100), folder: z.string().max(100).default('devotionals') }. Build Cloudinary signed upload URL: timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now()/1000), publicId = nanoid(12), paramsToSign = `folder=${folder}&public_id=${publicId}&timestamp=${timestamp}`, signature = createHmac('sha1', env.cloudinaryApiSecret).update(paramsToSign + env.cloudinaryApiSecret).digest('hex'), return { uploadUrl: `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${env.cloudinaryCloudName}/auto/upload`, fields: { api_key: env.cloudinaryApiKey, timestamp, public_id: publicId, folder, signature } }. archiveToSupabase input: { cloudinaryUrl: z.string().url(), fileName: z.string().max(500) }. Fetch file from cloudinaryUrl, PUT to Supabase Storage, call logMediaUpload, return { supabaseUrl }. Catch errors and throw TRPCError INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR on failure.
Step 13 — api/router.ts: Add `import { mediaRouter } from './mediaRouter';` and add `media: mediaRouter` to the appRouter object.

Step 14 — api/auth-router.ts: Add `adminQuery` to the import from './middleware'. Add promoteToElevatedAdmin mutation: adminQuery.input(z.object({ userId: z.string().uuid() })).mutation(async ({ input }) => { const db = getDb(); await db.update(schema.users).set({ role: 'elevated_admin', updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(schema.users.id, input.userId)); return { success: true }; }). Also add .trim() to the name field in updateProfile: change z.string().min(1).max(255).optional() to z.string().trim().min(1).max(255).optional().

Step 15 — api/lib/db.ts: Add comment block at the very top (after existing banner comment) explaining: '// Priority chain: 1. Neon (NEON_DATABASE_URL) — preferred for fast serverless reads/writes and branching. 2. Supabase PostgreSQL (DATABASE_URL) — auth source-of-truth and fallback. 3. Dev stub — graceful no-op for local dev without any DB configured. The getDb() function implements this chain automatically.'
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors after all steps
elevatedAdminQuery is exported from api/middleware.ts and blocks non-admin/non-elevated_admin users with FORBIDDEN
adminQuery is used for telegramRouter messages and processMessage procedures
All devotional string inputs use .trim().max(N) via Zod
Webhook route in boot.ts validates x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token header
Scheduler in boot.ts fires pollTelegramMessages() at 2am and 4am only when env.telegramBotToken is set and !isServerless
mediaRouter is registered in router.ts as 'media'
promoteToElevatedAdmin is available on authRouter and restricted to adminQuery
db/schema.ts exports MediaUpload and InsertMediaUpload types
db/supabase-schema.sql has ALTER TABLE for media_url and CREATE TABLE for media_uploads with RLS
verification: npm run check — TypeScript type check must exit 0
npm run build — full bundle must exit 0
findings: All 15 steps implemented and verified (npm run check and npm run build both exit 0). Key exports for FEAT-002: elevatedAdminQuery (api/middleware.ts), mediaRouter (api/mediaRouter.ts, registered as 'media' in appRouter), MediaUpload/InsertMediaUpload types (db/schema.ts), logMediaUpload (api/queries/media.ts), getDevotionalById/createDevotional/updateDevotional/deleteDevotional/publishDevotional (api/queries/devotionals.ts), insertTelegramMessage/markTelegramMessageProcessed/getTelegramMessageById/listTelegramMessages (api/queries/telegram.ts), promoteToElevatedAdmin mutation on authRouter (adminQuery-guarded). Scheduler fires pollTelegramMessages() at 2am and 4am only when env.telegramBotToken is set and !isServerless. Webhook validates x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token header (skips check if env.telegramWebhookSecret is empty). devotionalRouter create/update/delete/publish all use elevatedAdminQuery. telegramRouter messages/processMessage use adminQuery. broadcastDevotionalChanged fires a fire-and-forget POST to Supabase Realtime broadcast after every devotional mutation.
